Hi guys, I was wondering if we could have a discussion about rule 3 - no memes. We talk about this one each time the sidebar rules are up for review and there never seems to be any strong feelings for or against it. Recently a meme hit the front page after being upvoated very quickly, and rather than remove the post it made me wonder if rule 3 still reflects the /v/gaming community's wishes or not.

So please weigh in on rule 3 and how you would like to see /v/gaming handle memes moving forward, whether that's continuing the ban, updating the language, or doing away with the rule altogether.

Currently rule 3 states:

No Memes or DAE posts

Meme, defined here is: ''An image, video, piece of text, etc., typically humorous in nature, that is copied and spread rapidly by Internet users, often with slight variations.'' I'd like to do that next, after this post has been stickied for a week or two to make sure everyone in /v/gaming's community has a chance to weigh in on memes.
